dialogue_texts: Marisa
Well, look at this place. Creeping around a giant mansion in the dead of night...
Marisa
Now this is my kind of investigation!
Hiroyuki
My Majesty, I must warn you, Fusana is not in her right mind.
Hiroyuki
The nighttime has transformed her into a princess, but she is heavily infected by the glohm.
Marisa
I've seen her nighttime appearance before. No need to warn me.
Marisa
I'll go knock some sense into her and see what she's hiding.
Hiroyuki
I would gladly dance with her myself, but I cannot risk catching the infection.
Hiroyuki
Please, strip the Glohm away from her. I shall wait where it is safe.
Marisa
Leave the heavy lifting to a professional.
Fusana
Leave me... let me sleep... Unless my partner wakes me with a kiss, I shall remain in this nightmare...
Marisa
Fusana, you are not a sleeping beauty.
Marisa
My Mini-Hakkero has the spark to break that trance.
Fusana
Cold... so cold... If you dare disturb my rest, the shadows of the Order will consume you!
Marisa
If they're the ones messing up my Friday routine, they're gonna pay!
Marisa
Let's see what kind of danmaku a glohmed princess can throw!
